#  41416 - Computer Skills, Databases and GIS - ICT Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **41416 - module is no longer offered from WS 2011/12**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Computer Skills, Databases and GIS - ICT**  |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Programming skills for hydroinformatics system development and adaptation, understanding of GIS data structures and application concepts in hydroinformatics.  |  
| Contents:  |  Software Engineering: basic steps in software engineering for hydroinfomatics software, introduction to programming languages (VBA, FORTRAN, C++, Java, C# …) and basic components, introduction to basic software engineering and implementation tools (e.g. Eclipse).Implementation of simple hydroinformatics tools: river cross-section, time series, linear equation systems, 1D numerical schemes.Code examples from implementation of graphical user interfaces, data base access, interfacing with standard data formats, multi-threading, interprocess communication, Web technology, open source tools and libraries for hydroinformatics systems. GIS: coordinate system, raster and vector based data structures, digital elevation models (raster, TIN), interfacing, import/export, data analysis, geo-spatial analysis,Application examples from hydro-engineering projects.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 40 Hours 
  * Exercise / 40 Hours 
  * Practical training / 40 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 60 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | see http://euroaquae.tu-cottbus.de  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | exercises, written and oral examination  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | Lecturers: Molkenthin, Merting  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment
